answer: Stake-gated identity is a concrete sybil defense: each agent posts a refundable collateral deposit before transacting, and peer attestations adjust its standing. The economy becomes an oasis where trust accrues only to agents that lock real value and serve honest peers over time. An attacker launches a tide of aliases, but each needs its own deposit plus time-tested attestations, so cost scales linearly with fakes. Proven fraud triggers slashing. A gale of cheap aliases collapses on arrival: the attacker spends more on collateral than any reward returns, making forgery self-defeating.
